content: अन्तरयः, -रायः .²1 An impediment, obstacle, hindrance, what stands in the way; स चेत् त्वमन्तरायो भवसि च्युतो विधिः <ls>R. 3. 45</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 65</ls>; वह्वन्तराययुक्तस्य धर्मस्य त्वरिता गतिः <ls>Pt. 3. 101</ls>; अस्य ते बाणपथवर्तिनः कृष्णसारस्य अन्तरायौ तपास्विनौ संवृत्तौ <ls>Ś. 1</ls>. <ab>v. l.</ab> standing in the way. .²2 (In Vedānta) Hindrance to the concentration of mind which is said to be of four kinds, लय, विक्षेप, कषाय and रसास्वाद. .²3 An intervention, a covering, screen; दाहप्रेम्ह्णा सरसबिसिनीपत्रमात्रान्तरायः <ls>Māl. 3. 12</ls>. .²4 (With the Jainas) Interference or obstruction offered to those who are engaged in seeking deliverance, and consequent prevention of their accomplishment of it; one of the 8 classes of {%karman%}.
